## Reduced provisioning strength and a separate evening report

**Sources on this page:** p220 A2, p220 B.

**Related source pages:** [p219 D1](219.md#source-p219-d1).

<a id="edition-cases-military-nov25-provisions-and-evening-report-reduced-provisioning-strength-and-a-separate-evening-report"></a>



**Source review and edition: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.**

Two physically numbered parts request a complete stop to provisions after
a reduction in the strength being provisioned. The existing shared-square
interpretation identifies their army field as **11th Army**. Their association
is explicit across the p219/p220 page break. A separate evening report on
p220 now supports **Tiszafoeldvar, Nagymagocs and Kondoros** as places reached,
while its unit labels remain incomplete. All three retain their complete
native printed frames.

<a id="source-p220-a2"></a>
<a id="edition-cases-military-nov25-provisions-and-evening-report-p220-a2"></a>

### p220 A2

**Source transcription — header:** `A) UKS v ZÖN (10.11 p.m., November 25th); 1849 2 TLE; 2 TL RICHI-244`

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — every native source slot in printed order, with non-coordinate glyphs masked:**

```text
BITTENACHSCHUBANVERPFLEGUNGSOFOR3GANZEINSTELLENXGLEICHESTELEGRAMMGEHTANGENENALINTENDANTUNDPROVIANTDEPOTDRESDENXXVIERAXU203
```

**Edited output — 2 observed-coordinate substitutions and 0 source-mask fills; no insertion, deletion or reordering:**

```text
BITTENACHSCHUBANVERPFLEGUNGSOFORTGANZEINSTELLENXGLEICHESTELEGRAMMGEHTANGENERALINTENDANTUNDPROVIANTDEPOTDRESDENXXVIERAXU203
```

</details>

**Readable German — exact nonseparator labels of the edited output:**

> Bitte Nachschub an Verpflegung sofort ganz einstellen. Gleiches Telegramm geht an Generalintendant und Proviantdepot Dresden. VIERA. U203.

**Meaning:** The continuation requests an immediate, complete halt to further provisions and states that the same telegram goes to the Generalintendant and the provisions depot at Dresden. It records a request and notification, without proving that deliveries actually stopped. The closing labels VIERA and U203 remain unexpanded.

**Editorial limits:**

- The complete native 244-coordinate body matches its header. Two earlier OCR blocks split this one physical source part; neither block alone gives its full geometry.
- SOFOR3 → SOFORT and GENENALINTENDANT → GENERALINTENDANT are separately priced ordinary-word proposals, with no global reinterpretation of the 3 label.
- VIERA and U203 remain literal closing fields. They are not silently converted to an office, a personal name, a number or an expanded date.
- The source explicitly marks this as part 2 and repeats the p219 D header. Its association with that first part is supported by printed metadata as well as the continued marker, not solely by similar meaning.

### p220 B

**Source transcription — header:** `B) UKS v ZÖN (09.54 p.m., November 25th); HATTE MR 20[4-like]7; RICHI-220`

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — every native source slot in printed order, with non-coordinate glyphs masked:**

```text
ABENDMELDUNG13XJJ22ALPEXKX16X1ZUIGEXESHABE7MITANFAENGENERREICHT1J0IDXTISHAFOELDVARXPRDXNAGQMAGOCS81J8XKONDOROS
```

**Edited output — 1 observed-coordinate substitution and 0 source-mask fills; no insertion, deletion or reordering:**

```text
ABENDMELDUNG13XJJ22ALPEXKX16X1ZUIGEXESHABENMITANFAENGENERREICHT1J0IDXTISHAFOELDVARXPRDXNAGQMAGOCS81J8XKONDOROS
```

</details>

**Readable German — exact nonseparator labels of the edited output:**

> Abendmeldung 13. JJ22 ALPE. K. 16. 1 ZUIGE. Es haben mit Anfaengen erreicht: 1J0ID, TISHAFOELDVAR. PRD, NAGQMAGOCS81J8. KONDOROS.

**Meaning:** The recoverable clause in this separate evening report states
that leading elements had reached the following listed entries. This earlier
label-based display preserves its unit, time-like and garbled place labels;
the two separate place readings below have additional evidence.

<a id="edition-cases-military-nov25-provisions-and-evening-report-a-shared-letter-identifies-nagymágocs"></a>

#### A shared letter identifies Nagymágocs

The later [shared `AD=Y` interpretation](../experiments/nov25_treaty_digits/README.md#the-shared-y-in-strzemieczny-and-nagymagocs)
turns `NAGQMAGOCS` into **`NAGYMAGOCS`**. At plaintext position 90,
the pair comes from the originally observed **A at source 74 and D at
source 180**. This is the same cell that completes Strzemieczny's surname
in p224 C1; neither name requires an added source-coordinate repair.

The place spelling is independently printed in *Csongrád vármegye
Hivatalos Lapja*, **21 December 1912**, no. 59, p349, items 86–89, in
the municipality's proposed 1913 budgets.
[National-library scan](https://epa.hu/05200/05279/00539/pdf/EPA05279_csongradvarmegye_hivatalos_lapja_1912_059.pdf)
· [Masthead](../experiments/nov25_treaty_digits/sources/csongrad_1912_title.png)
· [Nagymágocs entries](../experiments/nov25_treaty_digits/sources/nagymagocs_1912.png).
The newly identified place is one location that leading elements
reportedly reached; the adjacent unit labels remain unresolved. The other
damaged place has the separate native witness described next.
The gazette supplies a geographical spelling, not a separate account
of the reported military movement.

<a id="edition-cases-military-nov25-provisions-and-evening-report-a-native-place-witness-under-a-different-key"></a>

#### A native place witness under a different key

The 30 November evening report [p229 A1](229.md#edition-cases-military-late-transport-dispatches)
directly reads **`TISZAFOELDVAR`** at positions 41–53, using 26 untouched
observed coordinates under its different Nov28–Dec1 key. Its Z is `VX`,
from source 219 V and 148 X. That native spelling supports the earlier
`TISHAFOELDVAR` place repair.

In p220 B, H at position 72 comes from `AA`, source 6 and 150. The
proposed change **6 A→D**, retaining source 150 A, gives `DA=Z`.
The original image visibly has A; this is an observed-coordinate repair,
not a corrected transcription. The older `HABE7→HABEN` repair at source
157 remains separate, for **two total observed substitutions**, no fills
and the unchanged 220-coordinate frame.

**Conditional interpretation — shared Y and the witnessed place spelling, with unit labels retained:**

> Es haben mit Anfaengen erreicht: 21?ID, Tiszafoeldvar. PRD, Nagymagocs. ?21?, Kondoros.

This makes the place list readable as Tiszafoeldvar, Nagymagocs and
Kondoros while preserving its incomplete unit labels. The donor is a
separate later report, not a duplicate reception; it supports the
spelling without establishing this report's unit identities or movements.
The [cross-key place check](../experiments/nov25_evening_place_witness/README.md)
prices all 98 possible starts of that spelling in the native recipient
frame. Position 69 is the only one-substitution minimum for this fixed
word and frame. The conditional fixed-position count stays **103/110**:
H was already observed, so this repair does not recover an erased position.

**Editorial limits:**

- All 220 observed coordinates remain in their native order. The earlier primary word proposal HABE7 → HABEN is priced as an observed-coordinate change, not as a free reading of a numeral; the new place repair adds one separately recorded change.
- 13, JJ22ALPE, K, 16, 1ZUIGE, 1J0ID, TISHAFOELDVAR, PRD, NAGQMAGOCS81J8 and KONDOROS keep their exact labels. Word spacing in the opening is editorial and does not establish its syntax or reference values.
- The original edition supplies no unit number or geographical correction. Its TISHAFOELDVAR and NAGQMAGOCS remain in the exact label stream. The separate shared-Y interpretation and one-coordinate witnessed repair identify those two places in the current reading.
- The HATTE MR heading contains a 4-like glyph rendered as [4-like] in the metadata. This is a header transcription qualification and does not add a source-ciphertext erasure or a decoded position.
- B has its own source label and reception time. It is not counted as a third part of the two-part provisioning message above.

### Evidence, credit and reproduction

Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier repository OCR and unchanged-key outputs are retained separately. Source review and explicit editorial work: icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.

The certificates independently reconstruct column positions and domains, compare them with the cipher implementation, replay every priced change, and check all readable nonseparator labels. Partial readings have one consistent injective square/source-mask completion witness that re-encrypts exactly; those witness choices are not historical identifications. Source images are bound to the original PDF by page, rectangle, scale, file digest and pixel digest.

Reproduce with `python experiments/nov25_provisions_and_evening_report/verify.py --verify`. Add `--pdf /path/to/adfgvx-childs.pdf` to check the original PDF and exact source-crop pixels.

### p219 D1

**Source transcription — header:** `D) UKS v ZÖN (10.11 p.m., November 25th); 1849 2 TLE; 1 TL RICHI-166`

<details>
<summary>Source and cipher evidence</summary>

**Raw output — every native source slot in printed order, with non-coordinate glyphs masked:**

```text
INFOLGEVERRINGERTERXVERPFLEGUNGSSTAERKEFUERJJXARMEEKEINEVERPFLEGNNGFEHRERFOGDERLICH
```

**Edited output — 3 observed-coordinate substitutions and 0 source-mask fills; no insertion, deletion or reordering:**

```text
INFOLGEVERRINGERTERXVERPFLEGUNGSSTAERKEFUERJJXARMEEKEINEVERPFLEGUNGMEHRERFORDERLICH
```

**Readable German — exact nonseparator labels of the edited output:**

> Infolge verringerter Verpflegungsstaerke fuer JJ. Armee keine Verpflegung mehr erforderlich.

</details>

**Conditional interpretation — existing shared FX=1 interpretation and the same three word repairs:**

> Infolge verringerter Verpflegungsstaerke fuer 11. Armee keine Verpflegung mehr erforderlich.

**Meaning:** Under the existing shared-square interpretation, the message
states that the 11th Army's reduced provisioning strength makes further
provisions unnecessary. The next part requests an immediate, complete
halt to further supplies.

The two original `FX` pairs at plaintext positions 43–44 come from
source **10 F + 83 X** and **53 F + 133 X**. Neither was touched by the
three word repairs. Their `11` reading follows the already supported
`FX=1` assignment; this passage introduces no new numeral choice or
source change. The [separate follow-up certificate](../experiments/nov25_evening_place_witness/certificate.json)
checks both pairs and the complete current quotation.

**Editorial limits:**

- All 166 observed coordinates are present, including the final printed VGGXA F omitted by the earlier 160-coordinate OCR block. Restoring those visible coordinates is a transcription correction, not a hypothetical lost-prefix or missing-slot fill.
- The word proposals VERPFLEGNNG → VERPFLEGUNG, FEHR → MEHR and ERFOGDERLICH → ERFORDERLICH have explicit observed-coordinate costs. All raw garbles remain displayed.
- JJ remains literal in both earlier label streams above. The separately certified shared-square interpretation supplies 11 in the current reading; no headcount or additional key assignment is inferred.
- The printed continued marker, identical UKS/ZÖN routing, 10.11 p.m. interception, 1849 internal reference and 2 TLE count associate this first part with p220 A2. The source changes its section label from D to A across the page break.

</details>

## Mackensen's appeal over disarmament and internment

**Sources on this page:** p220 C1, p220 C2, p220 C3, p220 C4.

**Related source pages:** [p221 A5](221.md#source-p221-a5), [p221 A6](221.md#source-p221-a6).

<a id="edition-cases-military-mackensen-armistice-appeal-mackensens-appeal-over-disarmament-and-internment"></a>



**Prior body identification:** Childs; summarized by George Lasry, Ingo
Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016). **Source edition and exact repair
audit:** icekylinx and GPT-6 Astra Pro.

This six-part message reports Berthelot's communication of Foch's refusal
to apply the Western armistice conditions to the German southeastern front,
and a demand for disarmament and internment of Mackensen's army group.
The proposed German edition distinguishes acknowledging receipt while a
decision is pending, disarmament by Hungary, and a request to forgo
internment. Its fifth part is a conditional reconstruction of a genuinely
short source frame. The closing warns of mass flight, misery and open
resistance.

The [conditional Article XII numeral interpretation](../experiments/nov25_treaty_digits/README.md)
clarifies four positions in the closing reference: raw `JAJJ6J4` becomes
`1A11?1?`. It adds no source change. The earlier repairs of raw
`MITGETEILJ` and `SOLLJE` remain necessary; those received `J` labels would
otherwise become 1 under the same assignment.

The source is [Childs's collection](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1_JiNMck7eUvdrOTrH7fsj1Yh44t-VSC6/view),
printed **p220 C1–C4 and p221 A5–A6**, PDF pages 223–224. The repeated header
links the six parts:

<details>
<summary>Literal source transcription</summary>

**Source transcription — clear header and/or literal source record:**

```text
NKJ v UKS (05.24 p.m., November 25th)
1620 (11/25) KR MIM 6 TLE
FUR LP
```

</details>

Both pages are headed 25 November 1918. The scan's `1620` differs from the
`16:30` time in the earlier research-paper summary; the source time is
preserved without resolving that difference. The published `Nov25-28`
square and transposition are unchanged.

### p220 C3: limited acknowledgment and conditional proposal

The page prints **206 valid coordinates**. Earlier OCR omitted the complete
final `DDADF D`, producing an incorrect 200-coordinate frame. Restoring
those six observed coordinates gives:

<details>
<summary>Raw decoded text</summary>

**Raw output:**

```text
OHLXLEDIGLICHBESTAETIGENXSOLLJEALLGEMXLAGEERFUELLUNGFRANZXFORDERUNGVERLANGEBXMUESSTEERREICHTWERDENKDASU
```

</details>

Five observed-coordinate substitutions give the same-length candidate:

<details>
<summary>Proposed text and exact labels</summary>

**Edited output:**

```text
OHLXLEDIGLICHBESTAETIGENXSOLLTEALLGEMXLAGEERFUELLUNGFRANZXFORDERUNGVERLANGENXMUESSTEERREICHTWERDENXDASS
```

</details>

With editorial spacing: “… OHL lediglich bestätigen. Sollte allgem. Lage
Erfüllung franz. Forderung verlangen, müsste erreicht werden, dass …”
In particular, `SOLLJE` becomes `SOLLTE`; an extra letter is not added to
turn it into `SOLL DIE`.

Parts C2–C3 support **merely acknowledging receipt pending OHL's decision**.
That limited acknowledgment is distinct from accepting the demands. The
earlier paper paraphrases the timing differently; this edition presents
the German wording and its costs so the distinction can be assessed.

The source contains **244 valid coordinates**. Its final `XGGG` was omitted

### p221 A5: conditional missing-prefix reconstruction

The source advertises **232** coordinates but actually prints **222 slots**,
including three dashes. This discrepancy is present in the scan. Under
the representative model of ten absent coordinates at the beginning, the
raw reading is:

<details>
<summary>Raw decoded text</summary>

**Raw output — conditional 232-slot frame with ten absent leading coordinates:**

```text
ABS?AN0GE?OMME?WIRDKINTERN?ERUNGWUERD?NACH5EMSOEB?NKAR?ATHTN?NTERGROESST?NANSTRENGU?GENUEBERSCH?ITTENUNDAB?U?NSPORTE
```

</details>

Six observed-coordinate substitutions, three printed-dash fills and ten
inserted-coordinate fills give:

<details>
<summary>Proposed text and exact labels</summary>

**Edited output — same conditional leading-gap frame, with the stated repairs and fills:**

```text
ABSTANDGENOMMENWIRDXINTERNIERUNGWUERDENACHDEMSOEBENKARPATHENUNTERGROESSTENANSTRENGUNGENUEBERSCHRITTENUNDABTRANSPORTE
```

</details>

With editorial spacing: “… Abstand genommen wird. Internierung würde,
nachdem soeben Karpathen unter grössten Anstrengungen überschritten und
Abtransporte …” The received formulation has no article before `Karpathen`;
none is inserted.

Read with C4, the stated candidate asks that internment be **forgone**,
while its intervening clause says that provisioning would make Hungary
the only feasible location. The wording is more specific than a summary
that merely proposes internment in Hungary. This interpretation inherits
the explicit missing-prefix and ordinary-word assumptions; the absent
coordinates are not independently witnessed by another transmission.

<a id="edition-cases-military-mackensen-armistice-appeal-all-declared-loss-placements-are-retained"></a>

#### All declared loss placements are retained

The audit checks all **223** placements of one ten-coordinate gap and all
**24,976** ordered placements of two five-coordinate gaps. The complete
retrospective candidate has a unique minimum of six observed-coordinate
changes when both missing groups precede source index 0.

That is not independent proof of the location. Masking `ABSTANDGENOMMENWIRD`,
`INTERNIERUNG` and `KARPATHEN` leaves five two-group minima, each with four
changes on the remaining template: **(0,0), (1,1), (1,2), (2,2), (3,3)**.
All are preserved. Their raw readings share **100 of 116 fixed positions**.
The book and radio scores also rank the leading gap first, but language
